codeReview.summary: The fix correctly restores edge-case scenario coverage in the scenario-manifest generator and regenerated manifests, including required edge IDs and platform_skip metadata for symlink/one-device scenarios. Compared against the original failed feature diff/review, this commit resolves the manifest-regeneration gap without regressing previously established one-device and large-file integrity protections present at the reviewed commit.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The edge-scenario integrity check enforces only that at least one edge scenario exists, not that the expected edge scenario set is present; this allows silent coverage shrinkage.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: scripts/parity/validate_fixture_integrity.py:268 checks len(edge_scenarios) > 0 for edge_scenarios_present, but no required-ID set assertion exists.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Common manifest-integrity verification commands used by workers are not codified in services.yaml, leading to ad-hoc command execution patterns.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Feature verificationSteps in mission features.json require `python3 scripts/bench/build_scenario_manifest.py --verify` and `python3 scripts/parity/validate_fixture_integrity.py`, but .factory/services.yaml has no dedicated entries for these commands.

summary: Pass. The feature restores and preserves required edge-case scenario entries after manifest regeneration and keeps prior one-device/large-file failure remediations intact at the reviewed commit state.
